summary: With 80 active spuds spanning six diverse regions and 33 permits signaling a strong pipeline, now is the time to lock in fluid contracts before competitors fill the demand gap.

top._headline: Active decision window open now on Chevron Duvernay well
top._insight: With mud contracts historically awarded 10-14 days pre-spud and the estimated spud date of September 24, the contracting decision for this Chevron Canada Kaybob South well is being made right now, making immediate engagement critical. This lead carries medium data confidence — the strongest in the dataset — giving it a decisive edge over the several priority-9 competitors burdened by low-confidence intelligence. Newpark holds the regional preferred-vendor agreement but faces real pressure from M-I SWACO, creating a genuine competitive opening for a technically differentiated supplier to insert itself into the conversation before the award is finalized.
